pages.title: Device information
pages.description: Model, serial number and firmware versions of this ONT.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.note: Stock pages only re-submit the form (pageReFresh); the new UI just re-fetches the runtime sources.

pages.notes: Stock template reads OBJ_DEVINFO_ID (ModelName, SerialNumber, HardwareVer, SoftwareVer, BootVer, ManuFacturerOui, SoftwareVerExtent, DeviceType, AccessType) and, only in EPON mode, OBJ_SgwGateWay_ID "IGD" param Mac (device MAC). None of ModelName/SerialNumber/versions are DB DMs (DevInfo only holds DeviceType/AccessType/ProvisioningCode etc.), so they come from board/flash data: candidates on the device are /proc/cpuinfo-style board files, the firmware version files under /etc, or a cspd query. BootVer and SoftwareVerExtent rows are display:none in stock. status_dev_info_t_fj.gch is a Fujian variant (adds LOID/OLT/ITMS/optical/WAN/VoIP summary); not used here. status_dev_info_gch.gch dumps hidden fields (incl. WLAN PSK!) for that variant; do not replicate. UI-text notes moved here: [SerialNumber]: GPON serial. Stock shows ManuFacturerOui + "-" + SerialNumber when ManuFacturerOui is set, otherwise blank. | [DeviceType]: Shown by stock only when env DevInfoEnable=1. Also stored in DB table DevInfo.DeviceType. | [AccessType]: Stock compares against "GPON"/"EPON"/"DSL"/"Ethernet". DB DevInfo.AccessType holds a numeric code. | [PonMode]: Stock prints the httpd env ponmode, not an OBJ parameter.

pages.title: IPv4 WAN connections
pages.description: Address, gateway, DNS and link state of each IPv4 WAN connection.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.note: Stock pages only re-submit the form (pageReFresh); the new UI just re-fetches the runtime sources.

pages.notes: Stock loops three OBJs (TypeValue=2, Ethernet/PON uplink): OBJ_ETHWANCPPP_ID (IPMode, WANCName, TransType, IsNAT, StrServList, IPAddress, ConnStatus, DNS1-3, GateWay, UpTime, WorkIFMac, ConnError), OBJ_ETHWANCIP_ID (IPMode, Addressingtype, WANCName, IsNAT, StrServList, IPAddress, SubnetMask, GateWay, RemainLeaseTime, ConnStatus, DNS1-3, WorkIFMac) and OBJ_ETHWANCBRIDGE_ID (WANCName, IPMode, StrServList). Rows with IPMode=="2" (IPv6-only) are hidden; static rows always shown. Config parts live in DB: WANC (WANCName, StrServList, IsNAT, IPMode, WorkIFMac, VLANID, DNS1-3 overrides), WANCIP (Addressingtype, static IPAddress/SubnetMask/GateWay), WANCPPP (credentials - never show). Live address/gateway/DNS/ConnStatus/UpTime/ConnError/lease are runtime: on the device use `ip -4 addr`, `ip route`, /proc/net/dev and the pppd/udhcpc state (resolv file, lease) of the matching interface; WANC row -> Linux ifname mapping still to be verified. WANC currently has 1 row in the user DB. UI-text notes moved here: [Type]: PPP rows: TransType; IP rows: Addressingtype; bridge rows: fixed "Bridge". | [SubnetMask]: IP (static/DHCP) rows only. | [ConnStatus]: IP rows only use Connected/Connecting/else Disconnected.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.note: Stock pages only re-submit the form (pageReFresh); the new UI just re-fetches the runtime sources.

pages.notes: Stock reads OBJ_ETHWANCPPP_ID and OBJ_ETHWANCIP_ID (TypeValue=2) params IPMode, WANCName, TransType, StrServList, GuaCurSrc, GUA1-3, GuaNum, IsOutPreferredLft1-3 (rendered as prefix length), PrefixCurSrc, Prefix1, Prefix1Len, GuaPd, DestAddress/ATMEncapsulation (DSL only), ConnStatusV6, DNSv6CurSrc, DNS1v6-3v6, Gatewayv6, Gatewayv6CurSrc, WorkIFMac; plus OBJ_ETHWANCBRIDGE_ID (WANCName, IPMode). Only rows with IPMode 2 or 3 are listed. OBJ_XDSLMODE_ID / PVC rows are DSL-only and dropped. All values are runtime (only WANC.IPMode and WANCPPP GUA/DNSv6/Prefix "Trigger" options are DB). Device sources: `ip -6 addr`, `ip -6 route`, the DHCPv6 client lease/state, /proc/net/if_inet6. UI-text notes moved here: [GUA1]: Stock appends "/" + IsOutPreferredLft1 (used as prefix length) when not "::". | [Prefix1]: Shown as Prefix1 + "/" + Prefix1Len. | [GuaPd]: Hidden in stock when "::".

pages.title: PON link information
pages.description: GPON registration state, FEC, optical module readings and GEM port counters.

fields.label: Optical signal
fields.help: When there is loss of signal, optical readings are not shown.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.note: Stock pages only re-submit the form (pageReFresh); the new UI just re-fetches the runtime sources.

pages.notes: Stock reads OBJ_PON_LOID_ID (PonLoid, LoidPasswd, LoidState - only LoidState is shown; never expose PonLoid/LoidPasswd here, they belong to the LOID config page), OBJ_GPON_FECSTATUS_ID (FecEnable), OBJ_PON_OPTICALPARA_ID (Volt, RxPower, TxPower, Temp, Current), OBJ_GPON_LOS_INFO_ID (LosInfo), and lists OBJ_PON_GEMPORTSTAT_ID (RxgemFrames, TxgemFrames, RxgemOctects, TxgemOctects, EncrypMode); stock hides the GEM tables (display:none) and the optics table unless env Right==1 (admin) or CountryCode==211. gpon_status_link_info_t.gch / _user.gch are the same page without GEM ports; pon_status_gemport_info_t.gch is the GEM table alone. None of this is in the DB. Device sources to verify: the vendor PON/optic driver (cspd PON module via `sidbg 1 -p`, gpon_omci, or /proc entries of the BOSA/optic driver). "GPON state" here is the LOID auth state, not the ONU O1-O5 PLOAM state; exposing the O-state too would be useful if the driver offers it. UI-text notes moved here: [LoidState]: Default (non-GD, CountryCode not 200/213) label set. GD variant: 0=fail/unregistered, 1=registered, 2-5=registered but unauthorised. | [LosInfo]: When 1 the stock page shows "--" for Rx/Tx power and bias current. | [RxPower]: Stock: raw/10000, 1 decimal. | [TxPower]: Stock: raw/10000, 1 decimal. | [Volt]: Stock shows raw*1000 labelled uV (raw is mV). | [Current]: Raw value shown as-is. | [Temp]: Stock: raw/1000. | [EncrypMode]: Stock: "0" = Disable, anything else = Enable.

pages.title: Wi-Fi status
pages.description: Radio state, channel, security and traffic counters of each SSID.

fields.label: SSID index
fields.help: SSID1–4 are 2.4 GHz, SSID5–8 are 5 GHz.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.note: Stock pages only re-submit the form (pageReFresh); the new UI just re-fetches the runtime sources.

pages.notes: Stock loops IGD.LD1.WLAN1..N (N = env wlanportnum) and skips SSIDs whose LocalSetEnable != 1. From OBJ_WLANCONFIG_ID it reads RadioStatus, ESSID, WEPAuthMode, BeaconType, WPAEncryptType, WPAAuthMode, 11iAuthMode, 11iEncryptType, Enable (all DB: WLANCfg rows 0-7, RadioStatus is WLANBase rows 0/1). From OBJ_WLANCONFIGDRV_ID (driver, runtime) it reads TotalPacketsReceived/Sent, TotalBytesReceived/Sent, ErrorsReceived/Sent, DiscardPacketsReceived/Sent, ChannelInUsed, Bssid, RealRF. Stock "WLAN connection status" column shows RadioStatus (radio on), not per-SSID Enable. Auth label derivation: None->NONE; Basic->WEP (+WEPAuthMode); WPA/11i/WPAand11i combined with *AuthMode PSK/EAP -> WPA-PSK, WPA2-PSK, WPA-PSK/WPA2-PSK, WPA-EAP, WPA2-EAP, WPA/WPA2-EAP. Runtime sources: /sys/class/net/wlanN/statistics/* or /proc/net/dev for counters, `iwconfig wlanN` / `iwpriv wlanN stat` for channel/BSSID, operstate for RealRF. e8_status_wlan_info_t.gch is the e8 variant of the same data (adds BSSID and error/discard rows). Associated-client list is not on any stock status page; see the WLAN group. UI-text notes moved here: [Band]: Verified: WLANBase row 0 Band=0 (2.4 GHz), row 1 Band=1 (5 GHz). | [Index]: 1-8 = WLANCfg row + 1; wlan0-3 = 2.4 GHz, wlan4-7 = 5 GHz.

pages.notes: Menu page status_ponlan_info_t.gch shows (a) a DHCP client table (see status-lan-clients) and (b) a port table from OBJ_PON_ETH_ID: InPkts, InOctets, OutPkts, OutOctets, Status, Speed, Duplex. Off-menu status_lan_info_t_user.gch and gpon_status_lan_info_t.gch add OBJ_BRGRP_ID (IPAddr, IPv6Addr, IPv6PrefLen of the LAN bridge) and per-port MACAddress and CRC from OBJ_PON_ETH_ID; both are merged here. DB has the config side only: LAND (IPAddr, NetMask, IPv6Addr...) and EthPortConf rows 0-3 (IFName, Enable, AutoNegEn, MaxBitRate, DuplexMode) - those belong to the network/LAN pages. Runtime sources: /sys/class/net/ethN/{carrier,speed,duplex,statistics/*}, `ip addr show br0` (bridge name to verify). epon_status_lan_info_t.gch is the EPON twin (BytesReceived/PacketsReceived/ErrorFrames param names). UI-text notes moved here: [Port]: LAN1-LAN4 = OBJ_PON_ETH_ID instance index + 1 (eth0-eth3). Stock CT build renames port 2 to "iTV" when portnum > 2; do not copy that. | [Status]: status_lan_info_t_user.gch mapping: 0 Up, 1 NoLink, 3 Disabled, other Error. status_ponlan_info_t.gch: 0 = connected, other = disconnected.
